About the University of West London

The University of West London (UWL) is a modern university in west London with campuses in Ealing and Brentford. It is known for career-focused teaching in areas such as business, hospitality, music, media and health.

Its location puts students close to central London while staying outside the most expensive zones. Always confirm details on the official university website.

Popular Courses for International Students

  • Business and Management: undergraduate and postgraduate business, international business and marketing routes.
  • Computing and Technology: computer science, cyber security and related programs.
  • Hospitality and Tourism: a well-known strength, with industry links.
  • Media, Film and Design: creative courses linked to London's media sector.
  • Nursing and Health: health-related courses; check eligibility for professional registration.
  • Music and Performing Arts: including courses linked to the music industry.

Course availability changes by intake, so check which programs open for 2027 before you apply.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the University of West London a good choice for international students?
It offers career-focused courses and a London location. Compare course content, fees and location with other options.
Does UWL offer a January intake?
Many courses do, but not all. Check the course page for your subject.
What visa funds do I need for London?
At the London rate you need £1,529 per month now, rising to £1,570 from 30 November 2026, for up to nine months.
